title: v0 committed monthly ledger table (v1)
description: One month of the append-only ledger: ledger/{YYYY-MM}.json. Implements FS-07 §10 (FS07-100) and VS-36 — at v0 there is no `pg` and no allocator, so the ledger is a committed table maintained by the operator script, carrying the same FS-07 §5.1 row shape and the same FS-07 §5.2 JCS/SHA-256 global hash chain that P-M3 imports unbroken (FS07-101). scripts/ledger-verify.mjs enforces the chain, the append-only law, and month immutability; this schema enforces the shape.

month.description: Month key, FS-00 §6.1 grammar. Must equal the filename stem.

note.description: Optional human note about the file itself (not a ledger fact). Ledger FACTS that need narrative are `month-note` / `annotation` rows, which are chained; this key is not, so it must never carry anything a reader could mistake for a recorded figure.

led_id.description: Platform-minted ULID, `led_` prefix, lowercase Crockford base32 (FS-00 §6.1).

seq.description: GLOBAL append order (FS-07 §5.2), contiguous from 1 across every month file. A row's chain predecessor is the row with `seq - 1` REGARDLESS OF MONTH — intake for an open month chains straight onto the current global head, so a later month may legitimately hold a lower seq than an earlier one. `seq` is the chain order; `month` is only a label.

month.description: Settlement month this row is assigned to (FS07-041). Must equal the file's `month`.

row_type.description: The v0 row-type whitelist. FS07-100 restricts the v0 ledger to intake types — `pool-in`, `refund-out`, `chargeback-out`, `topup-*`, `month-note` — and FS07-041's intake list adds `chargeback-reverse-in`; `annotation` is included because VS-36 requires the annotate-never-restate correction path to be expressible at v0 (FS07-042). NO ALLOCATION ROW TYPE EXISTS BEFORE P-M3: `levy`, `commons-alloc`, `directed-alloc`, `directed-to-commons`, `repo-pool`, `category-route`, `category-agg`, `rollforward-*`, `disburse`, `month-lock` and `adjustment` are all absent by design, and ledger-verify.mjs rejects them with a named error rather than a generic enum miss.

amount_minor.description: INTEGER minor units (FS-00 §6.1) in `currency`. Negative for the `-out` types; exactly 0 for `month-note` and `annotation`. No floating point ever enters the ledger.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the reporting currency for this row. The reporting currency is CHF as a working assumption; the ruling is URS OPEN-26.

src_amount_minor.description: Original transaction amount in minor units, where settlement was not in the reporting currency (ENG-037).

fx_rate.description: Rate captured AT THE TRANSACTION (FS07-041), as a decimal STRING — never a JSON number. Money math is integer-only and a float here would be the one place a rounding difference could enter the chain; a string cannot be silently arithmetic'd.

lane.description: Entitlement lane (VS-36). The product catalogue's lanes; only `project` and `donation` are purchasable at v0 (Pass/Portfolio are published schedule, not yet purchasable), but the enum is the full catalogue so a P-M3 import needs no widening.

hold_status.description: The M+1 chargeback hold (COM-023, ENG-025): intake is `held` until the hold on its settlement month has fully elapsed, then `released`. `not-applicable` for zero-amount narrative rows.

payer_name.description: Opted-in payer name, or the literal string `unnamed` (VS-36). Naming is opt-in; the default is `unnamed` and there is no code path that publishes a payer who did not opt in.

repo_node_id.description: Optional repo reference. Registry entries are the display cache; this is the key (FS-00 §6.1).

category_fund_id.description: Donor-designated fund for a `topup-donation-in` row (COM-064) — from the curated menu only.

schedule_version.description: Schedule version in force for this money-bearing row (ENG-084).

corrects_led_id.description: Forward-only correction pointer (FS07-042). Locked rows are immutable forever; a correction is a NEW row pointing back. Nothing in this repo can restate.

external_key.description: External idempotency key (Paddle transaction/adjustment id, bank statement line id) — unique across the ledger (ENG-065/066). Not personal data.

note.description: Required narrative for `month-note` and `annotation` rows. Part of the hashed row, so it is as immutable as an amount.

emitting_job.description: What wrote the row. At v0 this is the operator script (FS-05 §4.2 / VS-27's recording companion), never a job.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant with a `Z` offset and second precision — a fixed serialisation, because this field is inside the hash.

prev_hash.description: row_hash of the row at `seq - 1` in global order; 64 zeros at genesis. Excluded from its own row's hash input.

row_hash.description: SHA-256( prev_hash_hex_string || JCS(row minus prev_hash and row_hash) ), per FS-07 §5.2 with RFC 8785 canonical JSON. Recomputed by ledger-verify.mjs on every CI run.
